mapper.select: select e.evidence_id, e.memory_id, e.run_id, e.session_id, s.title as session_title, s.created_by_user_id as session_owner_user_id, e.observed_user_id, e.source, e.evidence_summary, e.observed_at from qa_memory_evidence e left join sessions s on s.session_id = e.session_id where e.memory_id = #{memoryId} order by e.observed_at desc, e.evidence_id asc

mapper.insert: insert into qa_memory_learning_outbox( job_id, run_id, session_id, workspace_id, user_id, application_id, agent_id, selected_model_id, status, attempts, available_at, claimed_by, lease_until, last_error_code, created_at, updated_at ) select #{jobId}, #{runId}, #{sessionId}, #{workspaceId}, #{userId}, #{applicationId}, #{agentId}, #{selectedModelId}, #{status}, #{attempts}, #{availableAt}, #{claimedBy}, #{leaseUntil}, #{lastErrorCode}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} where not exists (select 1 from qa_memory_learning_outbox where run_id = #{runId})
mapper.select: select job_id, run_id, session_id, workspace_id, user_id, application_id, agent_id, selected_model_id, status, attempts, available_at, claimed_by, lease_until, last_error_code, created_at, updated_at from qa_memory_learning_outbox where available_at <= #{now} and (status = 'PENDING' or (status = 'PROCESSING' and lease_until < #{now})) order by available_at, created_at limit #{limit}

select job_id, run_id, session_id, workspace_id, user_id, application_id, agent_id, selected_model_id, status, attempts, available_at, claimed_by, lease_until, last_error_code, created_at, updated_at from qa_memory_learning_outbox where job_id = #{jobId}

mapper.insert: insert into qa_memory_whitelist(user_id, enabled, updated_by_user_id, created_at, updated_at) values (#{userId}, #{enabled}, #{updatedByUserId}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}) on conflict (user_id) do update set enabled = excluded.enabled, updated_by_user_id = excluded.updated_by_user_id, updated_at = excluded.updated_at

merge into qa_memory_whitelist target using (values (#{userId}, #{enabled}, #{updatedByUserId}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})) incoming(user_id, enabled, updated_by_user_id, created_at, updated_at) on target.user_id = incoming.user_id when matched then update set enabled = incoming.enabled, updated_by_user_id = incoming.updated_by_user_id, updated_at = incoming.updated_at when not matched then insert(user_id, enabled, updated_by_user_id, created_at, updated_at) values(incoming.user_id, incoming.enabled, incoming.updated_by_user_id, incoming.created_at, incoming.updated_at)
